body.statement: For every fixed \(G\leq G_\star\), every fixed statistic \(T:\mathcal X_{m,K}\to\mathbb R\), and every \(C\in\mathcal X_{m,K}\), the conventional nonrandomized group-rank p-value satisfies \(p_G(C)\in\{1/2,1\}\) and \(\Pr_R\{p_G(C)\leq\alpha\}\leq\alpha\) for every \(R\in\mathcal R_0(n,K)\).
body.justification: The theorem states the exact inferential consequence of maximal common symmetry and no broader impossibility claim.
body.gap: The rank argument is informed by \cite{HemerikGoeman2018}; the substantive input is the newly derived orbit-size frontier from the alphabet-frontier theorem.
body.consumer: For the binary reply audit, it shows why conventional common-orbit ranks cannot reproduce the usual \(5\%\) HC2 or robust-\(t\) workflow studied by \cite{ZhaoDing2021}.
